messages:
sara (security): Heads-up: automated scan picked up a cross-account snapshot copy where the object metadata shows no server-side encryption header. Possible re-encrypt flag missing during transfer. cc @ben @priya :eyes:
ben (eng-ops): which snapshot? can you paste the copy-log id?
sara (security): log id `cp-9a3f` copied from `s3://backups-prod/tenant-99/snap-2026-03-21-01.tar.gz` -> `s3://ext-archive-us-east-2/tenant-99/` (acct 9988776655). copy metadata: `kms_reencrypted=false`, `sse=null`.
priya (eng-storage): hmm that's odd — our pipeline should always re-encrypt with dest CMK. did the replication job use the upload-agent or a manual aws cli copy?
ben (eng-ops): checking object HEAD now...
ben (eng-ops): output: ```
{
  "Key": "tenant-99/snap-2026-03-21-01.tar.gz",
  "LastModified": "2026-03-21T01:12:43Z",
  "ContentLength": 2147483648,
  "ETag": "\"abcd1234\"",
  "ServerSideEncryption": null,
  "Metadata": {
    "kms_reencrypted": "false",
    "uploader": "uploader-service-v2"
  }
}
```
arun (eng-infra): uploader-service-v2 should always call PutObject with `SSEKMS` using our dest CMK. if metadata says kms_reencrypted=false it implies the uploader skipped the SSE header or used presigned URL for PUT. we had a short-lived key rotation yesterday for uploader creds — could be related.
backup-bot: Automated rule #encops-23 triggered: cross-account s3 copy without SSE detected for bucket backups-prod at 2026-03-21T01:14:01Z. Suggested actions: suspend replication, revoke uploader principal, run object integrity scan.
matt (oncall): I'm isolating the destination bucket and applying an immediate bucket policy deny for `s3:PutObject` from account 9988776655. will also revoke uploader-service IAM keys in the next 60s.
sara (security): good. can we confirm whether any of those dest objects were accessed (GET) after copy? need to know potential exfil window.
ben (eng-ops): querying CloudTrail -> `LookupEvents` for s3:GetObject on that key: found 1 GET at 2026-03-21T01:25:09Z from IP 18.205.33.44 (AWS-managed service). looks like internal archive lifecycle job pulled it.
priya (eng-storage): archive job should have used role `archive-reader@our-org` — that role is trusted by ext account for cross-account copies. if that job fetched plaintext, it means we need to treat this as potential exposure.
arun (eng-infra): immediate mitigation plan: 1) suspend replication and isolate dest bucket (matt done) 2) rotate uploader-service keys and remove cross-account trust for uploader role 3) backfill missing SSE for objects we control by rewriting objects with correct SSE (where we have access) or deleting copies in external account 4) export full CloudTrail and S3 access logs for the timeframe.
matt (oncall): applying IAM policy now: ```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::9988776655:root"},
      "Action": "s3:PutObject",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::ext-archive-us-east-2/tenant-99/*"
    }
  ]
}
```
sara (security): also need to check KMS audit logs for any Decrypt/DecryptGrant events against our CMKs. if the copy used presigned URL it would bypass CMK usage. export CloudTrail LookupEvents for `kms:Decrypt` and any `kms:GenerateDataKey` around 01:00-02:00Z.
ben (eng-ops): running bulk query now. also flagging all snapshots with uploader="uploader-service-v2" AND kms_reencrypted=false — producing list.
priya (eng-storage): question for infra: do we have signed audit chain for cross-account copies? i.e., are we recording a signed transfer record that proves the destination re-encrypted? i recall a proposal but not sure it was implemented for uploads older than feb2026.
arun (eng-infra): we implemented transfer receipts in March but the rollout to `uploader-service-v2` was partial. these snapshots likely predate the rollout to that service variant. will prioritize enforcing receipts and failing copies without receipt.
sara (security): remediation checkpoints: 1) treat the ext copies as exposed until proven otherwise 2) notify legal / CISO and open incident (INC-2026-142) 3) ask tenant owner for notification decision 4) rotate tenant-level encryption keys if there was unauthorized access.
matt (oncall): INC created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-142 — I've set severity P2 and tagging: encryption-exposure.
ben (eng-ops): list of affected objects exported to /tmp/affected-tenant99.txt, uploading to incident runbook now.
priya (eng-storage): will coordinate rewrite/delete with ext-account ops contact. do we have a contact?
arun (eng-infra): digging: contact is `ops-ext@archive-partner.com` per marketplace contract. legal looped in on reachout wording. do not share PSKs or keys in thread.
sara (security): vuln triage notes: this looks operational misconfiguration (missing SSE header) triggered by partial rollout + credential rotation edge case. severity: high because cross-account copy happened + subsequent GET. follow-ups: - enforce transfer receipts and reject copies without SSE - require server-side enforcement via bucket policy as default - scheduled audit to scan for `ServerSideEncryption == null` across all backup buckets weekly.
matt (oncall): actions taken: bucket isolation done, uploader keys rotated, incident created. next: I'll request CloudTrail export and run a temporary deny on all cross-account PutObject to any external accounts for backup buckets.
ben (eng-ops): quick note: to find similar objects run: `aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket backups-prod --query 'Contents[?Metadata.kms_reencrypted==`false`].Key'` — will run across all tenants.
sara (security): thanks team. please add any relevant snippets to the incident ticket. we'll do a follow-up postmortem and CISO briefing. :lock:
priya (eng-storage): I'll handle the rewrite/delete plan with external ops and produce a remediation doc.
arun (eng-infra): I'll put a small policy guard in front of uploader-service to prevent presigned uploads without SSE and enforce `x-amz-server-side-encryption:aws:kms`.
matt (oncall): closing loop here for immediate ops. will ping when CloudTrail export done. :white_check_mark:
backup-bot: Note added to audit-chain: rule updated to block cross-account copies without SSE starting 2026-03-22T00:00:00Z.
sara (security): good. we'll review in postmortem. thanks everyone.
